entries.title: Genesis 48:1
segments: ¶Now it came to pass after these things that Joseph was told, "Indeed your father [is] sick"; and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

entries.title: Genesis 48:2
segments: And Jacob was told, "Look, your son Joseph is coming to you"; and Israel strengthened himself and sat up on the bed.

entries.title: Genesis 48:3
segments: Then Jacob said to Joseph: "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan and blessed me,

entries.title: Genesis 48:4
segments: "and said to me, 'Behold, I will make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will make of you a multitude of people, and give this land to your descendants after you [as] an everlasting possession.'

entries.title: Genesis 48:5
segments: "And now your two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you in Egypt, [are] mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

entries.title: Genesis 48:6
segments: "Your offspring whom you beget after them shall be yours; they will be called by the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

entries.title: Genesis 48:7
segments: "But as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way, when [there was] but a little distance to go to Ephrath; and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem)."

entries.title: Genesis 48:8
segments: ¶Then Israel saw Joseph's sons, and said, "Who [are] these?"

entries.title: Genesis 48:9
segments: And Joseph said to his father, "They [are] my sons, whom God has given me in this [place]." And he said, "Please bring them to me, and I will bless them."

entries.title: Genesis 48:10
segments: Now the eyes of Israel were dim with age, [so that] he could not see. Then Joseph brought them near him, and he kissed them and embraced them.

entries.title: Genesis 48:11
segments: And Israel said to Joseph, "I had not thought to see your face; but in fact, God has also shown me your offspring!"

entries.title: Genesis 48:12
segments: So Joseph brought them from beside his knees, and he bowed down with his face to the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 48:13
segments: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim with his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh with his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought [them] near him.

entries.title: Genesis 48:14
segments: Then Israel stretched out his right hand and laid [it] on Ephraim's head, who [was] the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh's head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh [was] the firstborn.

entries.title: Genesis 48:15
segments: And he blessed Joseph, and said: "God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, The God who has fed me all my life long to this day,

entries.title: Genesis 48:16
segments: The Angel who has redeemed me from all evil, Bless the lads; Let my name be named upon them, And the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; And let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth."

entries.title: Genesis 48:17
segments: Now when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him; so he took hold of his father's hand to remove it from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head.

entries.title: Genesis 48:18
segments: And Joseph said to his father, "Not so, my father, for this [one is] the firstborn; put your right hand on his head."

entries.title: Genesis 48:19
segments: But his father refused and said, "I know, my son, I know. He also shall become a people, and he also shall be great; but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his descendants shall become a multitude of nations."

entries.title: Genesis 48:20
segments: So he blessed them that day, saying, "By you Israel will bless, saying, 'May God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh!'" And thus he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

entries.title: Genesis 48:21
segments: Then Israel said to Joseph, "Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you and bring you back to the land of your fathers.

entries.title: Genesis 48:22
segments: "Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took from the hand of the Amorite with my sword and my bow."
